investigations.summary: pmm3-ui-tests #11995: PMM-T564 expected severity 'Notice' and got 'Info'. percona/pmm#6230 (PMM-15239) merged 2026-11-02 22:02 UTC and collapses the eight severity levels into four bands, so the test's raw-level assertion is now stale. Already fixed by pmm-qa#1674, which was a draft waiting on that merge and can be marked ready now. Deduped, not re-reproduced.

pmm3-ha-tests #161 on ROSA: PMM-T2108 got pg_exporter_scrapes_total from 2 of 3 PostgreSQL sources on all 3 attempts (23/24 passed). This is the known PMM-15794 (New), the same signature as nights 91/93/95/97, and pmm-qa#1710 proposes skipping it. Deduped, not re-reproduced.
